note: Iowa DNR park (one of Iowa's largest) on the oak-hickory bluffs along a big bend of the Des Moines River near Keosauqua; the campground is wooded and away from the river. Six family cabins. Firewood sold by the Friends group and hosts, Memorial Day into October. --Claude
summary: NEW: temporarily closed Nov 1 2026 to June 30 2027 (wastewater upgrade, posted 10/23/26). Season Apr 1-Oct 31 -> Mar 15-Nov 30; count 75 -> 64 campsites (75 included cabins, lodges, shelters); added 50A; fees confirmed by type; not waterfront holds; pin 320 m off.
flags: TEMPORARY CLOSURE written from ReserveAmerica's banner, posted 10/23/26: campground, cabins and beach house lodge closed Nov 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027. Iowa DNR's Alerts page wasn't confirmed separately; the DNR park page only points to it. Stored note had no closure.
PIN about 320 m off: stored 40.71028,-91.98139 is in forest northwest of the campground. Centroid of 65 ReserveAmerica GIS coordinates is 40.70853,-91.97844; pads visible on imagery there.

Not waterfront holds: ReserveAmerica tags every site 'Near Water - no'; imagery shows the loops under solid canopy with no water in a 1-km frame around the pin. Stored count of 75 was the park's whole reservable list.

Fees left as stored (Feb 15 2026 rate sheet still current: peak $36/$30/$24/$16, off-season $20/$20/$20/$12). Non-electric sites are grass, listed for RV, Site Length 54 on the one sampled, so base $12/$16 stands; no length field on those 13, one sample only. Max rig not written: listed lengths reach 110 and 134 ft, which look unreliable (next longest 104, 100, 100). Phone: 319-293-3502 on the page for the park office; the entry has none and apply.py won't write it.
Booking cutoff: ReserveAmerica's page also says reservations are accepted 'until 10:00 pm CST the day of arrival', in line with the DNR text in the state row's note. Nothing written.
